title: DDP with terminal gradient sync
scope: 2 dense Qwen-shaped layers · one 852 MiB BF16 bucket

verification.label: Measured PyTorch DDP · rank 0 compute and NCCL streams
verification.implementation: PyTorch 2.9.1 DistributedDataParallel using one 2048 MiB reducer bucket and the default all-reduce hook
verification.workload: Two dense Qwen-shaped layers, hidden 4096, 64 Q heads, 4 KV heads, SwiGLU 12288, sequence 4096, BF16 gradients, DDP=8
verification.measurement: 29.271 ms synchronized step; 28.611 ms displayed rank-0 GPU window; 893,428,736 gradient bytes
verification.timeline: Clean Nsight timing correlated with a separate module-labeled capture through rank-0 stream-7 kernel order.

description: This uses the real DDP reducer with a bucket cap larger than the complete 852 MiB BF16 gradient set. It is the concrete DDP equivalent of an unbucketed schedule: the only gradient all-reduce cannot launch until the final embedding gradient makes the single bucket ready.
The all-reduce is therefore a fully exposed 4.00 ms tail. Forward and root backward are fixed context; place the layer backward sequence, final bucket preparation, and terminal synchronization.

blocks.label: Fixed context: two-layer forward and cross-entropy
blocks.description: The replicated model executes the same two-layer forward graph independently on every data-parallel rank.

blocks.label: Fixed context: output projection and final norm backward
blocks.description: Output and final-normalization gradients are the first parameter gradients produced by reverse mode.

blocks.label: Layer 1 SwiGLU backward
blocks.description: Compute layer 1 down, up, and gate projection gradients before traversing its attention block.

blocks.label: Layer 1 attention backward
blocks.description: Backpropagate through output projection, Flash Attention, RoPE, QKV projections, and normalization.

blocks.label: Embedding backward and terminal bucket averaging
blocks.description: Produce the final embedding gradient, then average the complete BF16 bucket before launching NCCL. No earlier parameter gradient can trigger communication because every gradient belongs to this one bucket.

blocks.label: All gradients: 852 MiB all-reduce
blocks.description: All-reduce 893,428,736 BF16 gradient bytes across eight replicas. It has zero measured compute overlap and forms a 4.00 ms exposed tail.
